# glaf4-skill-set

A marketplace index of GLAF4 plugins for AI IDEs, currently distributing to Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

**Marketplace version:** `20260817183734`

**Authors:** D00000-Archt, mzdbxqh

This repository contains only marketplace manifests; the plugins themselves live in their own repositories.

[中文版](README.zh-CN.md)

## Add this marketplace

| Platform | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `/plugin marketplace add D00000-Archt/glaf4-skill-set` |
| OpenAI Codex | `codex plugin marketplace add D00000-Archt/glaf4-skill-set` |

## Using HTTPS instead of SSH

Claude Code clones marketplace repositories over SSH by default, which requires a GitHub SSH key (`ssh-keygen` + adding the public key to your GitHub account). If you prefer HTTPS, you have three options:

1. **Explicit HTTPS URL**: `/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/D00000-Archt/glaf4-skill-set.git`
2. **Environment variable**: set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS=1` before launching Claude Code.
3. **Git URL rewrite**: `git config --global url.https://github.com/.insteadOf git@github.com:`

OpenAI Codex uses HTTPS by default and does not require SSH configuration.
